question: Do the same ten native Cano train meshes satisfy noise-bounded replay when mesh surfaces are compared to opposite triangle surfaces rather than to different Poisson vertex samples?
reason: M0R2 passed S01-S07 and stopped at S08 only because three of 185205 replay vertices had no primary vertex within 0.75 m. The reverse nearest-vertex maximum was 0.844986 m, while exact inputs/axis/vertex, both mesh audits, triangle discretization, AABB and area passed. Read-only vertex-to-opposite-triangle-surface maxima were 0.494647/0.502614 m for S08 and <=0.510173 m across S01-S08.

single_method_change.removed: Use bidirectional nearest-vertex maximum <=0.75 m as a pass/fail surface replay criterion.
single_method_change.replacement: Query every vertex against the opposite triangle mesh with Open3D RaycastingScene.compute_distance and require both vertex-to-opposite-surface maxima <=0.75 m.
retained: exact graph, spline, operation trace, effective geometry parameters, axis and vertex count
AABB endpoint maximum coordinate difference <=0.5 m
record nearest-vertex distribution and both OBJ hashes without using them as identity
single_method_change.threshold_basis: The 0.75 m threshold is unchanged: sqrt(3)*0.4=0.692820 m paired post-Poisson noise bound plus 0.057180 m allowance. Only the geometric object is corrected from a non-corresponding vertex sample to the opposite triangle surface.

execution_policy: If approved, create one new immutable run from scratch; do not reuse failed-run meshes, change seeds, add parents, repair, retry, or inspect validation/development-test.
claim_boundary: M0R3 tests native perception-surface materialization stability only. PASS would permit an M1 proposal; it creates no formal dataset and does not qualify collision/navigation geometry.

estimated_cost.compute: Frozen E1 CPU; twenty native mesh materializations plus point-to-triangle-surface queries; no LiDAR, simulator or training.

approval.confirmation_reference: User replied 继续 after receiving the sealed M0R2 review and exact M0R3 point-to-surface proposal.
